key_insight: UFLD combines reinforcement learning with conformal prediction to classify wafer defects from adaptive measurements and stop when sufficient information is obtained.
engineering_relevance: Adaptive inspection could improve semiconductor production throughput by reducing acquisition time without requiring an additional learned confidence-estimation network.
method: Use reinforcement learning to select measurements adaptively.
Apply conformal prediction to quantify uncertainty after each acquisition step.
Stop acquisition once sufficient information supports classification.
evidence_signal: On MixedWM38, the authors report about 40% lower acquisition time and 98.4% inspection accuracy, with comparisons against existing adaptive acquisition procedures and standard CNNs.
watch_item: Deployment should validate uncertainty calibration and stopping behavior under shifts in defect patterns and measurement conditions beyond MixedWM38.
paper_title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
